description: Installed in your chest is an arc reactor that produces a large amount of power, forever!

A Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 500 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
A Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases the user's power capacity by 750 units.
A Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases the user's power capacity by 2000 units.

Concealed in your arm is a rifle chambered in .556. The rifle has no brand or anything, but does have a really cool HUD red hot to aid in shooting and goes away when your not aiming. Has a small hopper on the top to quickload loose rounds easily.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the arm rifle.
